title: The Screaming Operation Room
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro, Ran, Sonoko, Conan, Takagi, Inspector) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: actions are direct typed edges between the people/locations/objects involved. Old cases/ep625-626 file's culprit (Tsujiei Sonsaku) is confirmed correct by the transcript, but two of its details are wrong or garbled: (1) it says the sheet-and-feet trick was used 'under a table' -- the transcript is explicit the trick used a rigged hospital BED in the haunted house, not a table; (2) its motive text is cut off mid-sentence ('...he killed Tadami because she told Hashiguchi that if he was going to commit suicide, t...') and the real motive it was reaching for is different from what that fragment implies: Anna did not tell Hashiguchi to delay his suicide -- she asked him, before he died, to secretly video-record his own poisoning for her 'realistic death' research, then kept and repeatedly rewatched the tape instead of trying to stop him or report it. Tsujiei kills her in retaliation for that exploitation, mirroring the method (a cyanide capsule) Hashiguchi used on himself. The old file's clue text ('red-stained toenails matching blood transferred while preparing the victim's body') also collapses two separate clues into one: a square bedpost-shaped fake-blood mark hidden on Tsujiei's shoe sole, and separate toenail-shaped fake-blood lines left on the underside of the bed's top sheet. case_type: murder.

attrs.purpose: secretly set up, at Anna's request, to record Hashiguchi's suicide on video

attrs.disposition: pocketed by Anna from the hidden camera after his body was found; she rewatched it repeatedly

clues.desc: Fresh, bleeding scratch marks on Anna's cheek with skin and blood under her fingernails -- not make-up, and inconsistent with her supposedly having drawn her own fake blood; shows she clawed at someone's arm while her mouth/nose were being held shut, i.e. a real struggle, not a self-staged scare or suicide.

Red toenail-shaped lines on the sheet's underside match fresh fake blood found painted onto Tsujiei's toenails (not yet dry when he slid his legs into the bed) -- and rule out Mutsumi (wore sandals, no toenail marks possible) and Hachiya (bandaged foot he showed openly), leaving Tsujiei as the only person who could have left them.

edges.detail: the two frequently clashed over how death scenes should be acted for the film club
asked Hashiguchi, before his planned suicide, to let her secretly video-record his own poisoning for her research; did not try to stop him or report it

edges.method: forced a cyanide capsule into her mouth then sealed her mouth and nose shut until she swallowed it

edges.detail: hid inside the rigged bed after killing her and used the bedpost/foot-thump trick plus the blood-spray switch to make Ran's group believe she was still alive and struggling
